name: Unlearn

brand.tagline: Unlearn: popular beliefs where the evidence points another way, with graded evidence, named sources and a loop that keeps checking them. Run on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.

idea: An evidence encyclopedia of popular beliefs that the evidence contradicts (crime and justice, children and learning, how minds mislead, health, money and work, society and policy). Each entry starts from why the belief feels true, asks the reader to guess, then shows what the evidence found, where the intuition slips, what works instead and where the belief may still hold, with every source graded by design. An hourly loop resolves each source to a DOI and watches Europe PMC for new reviews, and readers' anonymous guesses and 'did this change your view' taps measure which beliefs surprise and which explanations work. The original coaching companion for adults around curious children stays at /coach.
goals: Keep every entry's evidence checked within 7 days: sources resolved to DOIs and new reviews surfaced on the entry, measured at /api/freshness
Reach a shift share of at least 0.3: readers who answer saying an entry changed how they see the belief, published at /api/metrics
Answer every logged curiosity at /coach with a coaching move and follow it up at 7 and 14 days
positioning: Unlearn is a spin-off of Rutger Bregman's Humankind ('they have to unlearn much of their training'): it helps people unlearn beliefs the evidence contradicts without telling them they are foolish, in the clickable, encyclopedic shape of Practical Solutions. No accounts, no cookies, no grades or streaks.

social.via: core publisher seed/worker/src/social.js on the platform's connected accounts, within social/gate.json
